summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any code or tests. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coords) pairs with coordinates in the original frame, set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes, docstrings updated); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator, GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter/transform/with_coordinates with worker splitting via np.ceil, len() check, and apply_transform on the patch alone; math import removed; PatchDataset docstring float alias fixed); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst adds a PatchIter autodoc entry; new tests/test_grid_dataset.py with test_shape and test_loading_array. Test images are two np.arange(16) 1x4x4 floats, inferred because they reproduce the pinned values. Pytest on tests/test_grid_dataset.py has not been run, so the pinned values are unverified. Lines 223-225 of utils.py were already over 120 characters and were left untouched. Nothing was committed.
